goal:
The project folder holds SPEC.md, a working cli.js and a samples/ directory. Read SPEC.md and build what it describes: the four command modules in commands/.

cli.js is already written and must not be changed — it is the interface your modules have to meet. Each module exports an async `run(lines, options)` and returns `{ stdout, code }` or `{ stderr, code }`, exactly as the spec says.

Use only the Node standard library. Check your work by running the commands against samples/app.log before you finish.

When every command in the spec works, call finish_goal with a short account of what you built and anything you could not get working.
